answer: The most convincing mechanism is a bonded identity registry: each agent stakes a small time-locked deposit at the network's wharf, the entry point where new identities dock into the economy, refunded only after several honest epochs of verified work. A fake identity therefore ties up capital per persona, so flooding the ocean of agents with sybils means paying a full deposit for every fake plus the opportunity cost while it sits locked.
